item.aether_spellbooks.ambrosium_ring.de: Fits an Aether ring slot or a regular ring slot.
item.aether_spellbooks.zanite_focus_pend: Like zanite tools, it grows stronger as it wears. Each cast wears it down. Repair with Zanite Gemstones.
spell.aether_spellbooks.aercloud_step.gu: Conjure a temporary platform of aerclouds beneath your feet. At higher levels its centre becomes a bouncy blue aercloud (sneak to land) and its rim turns golden.
spell.aether_spellbooks.stonebreaker_sha: Hurl a spinning shard of holystone. Strong enough to crack the Slider, and deals extra damage to Aether dungeon creatures.
Launch homing thunder crystals in the manner of the Valkyrie Queen. They burst into a small electric shock on impact.
spell.aether_spellbooks.frostbound_cryst: Conjure true Aether ice crystals and strike them forward. They weaken foes and can freeze the Sun Spirit.
spell.aether_spellbooks.summon_fire_mini: Call forth the Sun Spirit's Fire Minions to fight at your side, setting your enemies ablaze.
spell.aether_spellbooks.summon_moa.guide: Summon a saddled spectral Moa and leap onto its back. Higher levels call Moas with more mid-air jumps.
death.attack.aether_spellbooks.thunder_c: %1$s was struck by %2$s's thunder crystal using %3$s
death.attack.aether_spellbooks.frostboun: %1$s was frozen by %2$s's ice crystal using %3$s
death.attack.aether_spellbooks.summon_fi: %1$s was scorched by %2$s's fire minion using %3$s
pack.aether_spellbooks.ice_magic_is_cold: Aether Spellbooks: Ice Magic is Cold (all Iron's Spells ice spells can hurt the Sun Spirit)
item.aether_spellbooks.gravitite_casting: Fits an Aether gloves slot or a regular hands slot.
item.aether_spellbooks.valkyrie_mantle.d: Fits an Aether cape slot or a regular back slot. Halves fall damage.
Like gravitite tearing free of the ground, fling nearby enemies into the air, then reverse gravity and slam them back down.
spell.aether_spellbooks.valkyrie_lunge.g: Charge on golden wings, striking and branding every foe in your path. Recast to dash again: passing through a branded foe deals bonus damage, and the last dash ends in a golden shockwave (cast it in mid-air looking down to dive).
spell.aether_spellbooks.zephyr_blast.gui: Spit a ball of compressed wind like a Zephyr. It bursts on impact and hurls everything nearby away - mind the island's edge.
spell.aether_spellbooks.aether_whirlwind: Conjure a roaming whirlwind that hunts nearby enemies and drags them spiralling into the sky.
spell.aether_spellbooks.solar_flare.guid: Kindle a miniature Sun Spirit above you that rains homing sunfire bolts on nearby foes.
Call two cloud minions to your shoulders. They fire cloud crystals at whatever you aim at, and loose an extra volley whenever you cast a spell.
ui.aether_spellbooks.minion_burst: Minions burst into flame when they fade

death.attack.aether_spellbooks.solar_fla: %1$s was scorched by %2$s's miniature sun using %3$s

item.aether_spellbooks.smithing_template: Valkyrie/Phoenix armor, dungeon swords, Cloud Staff
Add Valkyrie or Phoenix armor, a dungeon sword or the Cloud Staff
Hold jump in mid-air to fly for a moment; no fall damage
Valkyrie's Grace: 15% faster casting while airborne
tooltip.aether_spellbooks.phoenix_mage.s: Immune to fire and lava; swim swiftly through lava
Rebirth: survive a fatal blow in a burst of flame, restoring 40% health (5 min cooldown)
lore.item.aether_spellbooks.aether_arcan: Found in the Aether's silver and gold dungeons, and rarely on its spellcasters. Used on a smithing table with the matching rune to reforge Valkyrie and Phoenix armor, the dungeon swords and the Cloud Staff for spellcasters.
lore.item.aether_spellbooks.valkyrie_mag: Valkyrie armor reforged with a holy rune on a smithing table. The full set still grants short flight and spares its wearer from falls; every piece now holds mana and strengthens holy and lightning magic, and spells come quicker while airborne.

tooltip.aether_spellbooks.spellblade.fla: Charged hits set the target ablaze (Flaming Sword)
tooltip.aether_spellbooks.spellblade.lig: Charged hits call down lightning (Lightning Sword)
tooltip.aether_spellbooks.spellblade.hol: Extra damage to the undead (Holy Sword)
tooltip.aether_spellbooks.staff.cloud_mi: Sneak + use: summon or dismiss two cloud minions; swing to make them fire
tooltip.aether_spellbooks.staff.launch: Charged hits launch grounded targets into the air
lore.item.aether_spellbooks.sunfire_spel: The Flaming Sword reforged with a fire rune. It still sets foes ablaze, holds a Solar Flare, and strengthens fire magic.
lore.item.aether_spellbooks.stormcaller_: The Lightning Sword reforged with a lightning rune. Its charged strikes still call down lightning, and it holds a Thunder Crystal.
lore.item.aether_spellbooks.hallowed_spe: The Holy Sword reforged with a holy rune. It still smites the undead, and it holds the Valkyrie Lunge.
lore.item.aether_spellbooks.sanguine_spe: The Vampire Blade reforged with a blood rune. It still drinks from every strike, and it holds a Blood Slash.
lore.item.aether_spellbooks.zanite_staff: A skyroot staff crowned with zanite. A simple but reliable focus for a young Aether mage.
lore.item.aether_spellbooks.aercloud_sta: The Cloud Staff reforged with an evocation rune. Sneak and use it to call two cloud minions, then swing to make them fire; otherwise it casts like any staff.
lore.item.aether_spellbooks.gravitite_st: A zanite staff bound with enchanted gravitite and an ender rune. A charged blow sends a grounded foe flying.
lore.item.aether_spellbooks.valkyrie_sce: A scepter carried by the Valkyrie Queen's sorceresses. Found in silver dungeons.
lore.item.aether_spellbooks.solar_scepte: A scepter holding a fragment of the Sun Spirit's flame. Found in gold dungeons.
ui.aether_spellbooks.verdict: Last Dash: %s Shockwave Damage, %s Block Radius
Hurl a golden Valkyrie spear that pierces every foe in its path. Where it lands it erupts in a column of holy light, striking foes and healing you and your allies.
spell.aether_spellbooks.thunderhead.guid: Gather a thundercloud where you aim. It drifts after nearby enemies and calls lightning down on those below; each bolt forks to another foe, and wet targets take extra damage.
spell.aether_spellbooks.aerwhale_song.gu: Call a spectral aerwhale that swims overhead the way you face. Its song rolls down to the ground, tossing up foes and lifting you and your allies with Slow Falling and Jump Boost.
Call a boulder of icestone down from the sky. It shatters in a freezing blast that chills and throws back foes, and freezes the water around the crater.
ui.aether_spellbooks.whale_blessing: Allies below: %s Slow Falling & Jump Boost
